brief: JPM's weekly HF positioning wrap: HFs est. down 1.5% today, -4% MTD, worst 5-day stretch (-3%+) since Apr 7 2025, and unlike Oct/early Nov this round is beta-driven not alpha-driven, resembling early Apr 2025. The Semis sell-off is not over; a 2018 analog (4Q selling to flat YTD, a late-Nov bounce before a deeper Dec leg down) is in focus. HFs have cut net risk at a magnitude historically tied to a bounce, but broader capitulation is unconfirmed: net selling is near -2z (over 2z in North America) and net-leverage deleveraging rivals 2018's most extreme episodes, yet the usual post-selloff rebound hasn't shown up, and US TPM's -1z 4wk change sits above the -1.5z capitulation trigger. Global positioning is low (near 10th percentile) but the drawdown is shallow; Japan keeps falling, China/HK and Europe stay low. US flows show defensive rotation: Semis remain most net-sold over 2 months though selling is slowing, while buying favors Utilities, Telecom, Pharma & Biotech, FBT, Real Estate, Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (highs), and Healthcare.
